requirements.quote:
When the loss detection timer expires, the timer's mode determines
   the action to be performed.
requirements.condition: When the loss detection timer expires
requirements.required_behavior: Select the timeout action according to the timer's current mode.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not perform a timeout action that is inconsistent with the timer's current mode.
requirements.why_checkable: A timer-expiry test can set each mode and observe which timeout branch executes.

requirements.condition: On entry to OnLossDetectionTimeout
requirements.required_behavior: Obtain the earliest loss time and its packet number space before choosing the timeout branch.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not choose the time-threshold branch without consulting the current loss time and packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify the lookup and that its results control the following branch.

requirements.condition: When the earliest loss time is nonzero on a loss-detection timeout
requirements.required_behavior: Detect and remove lost packets in the packet number space returned with the earliest loss time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not handle this timeout as a PTO before running time-threshold loss detection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can arrange a nonzero loss time and verify the detector is invoked for the selected space.

requirements.condition: After time-threshold loss detection is selected and DetectAndRemoveLostPackets returns
requirements.required_behavior: The returned lost-packet list must be nonempty.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue the time-threshold timeout path with an empty lost-packet list.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat an empty result as an assertion failure.
requirements.why_checkable: The detector result and assertion outcome can be observed directly.

requirements.condition: After a nonempty set of packets is newly detected as lost on timeout
requirements.required_behavior: Process that set through OnPacketsLost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit loss processing or pass a different lost-packet set.
requirements.why_checkable: A focused timeout test can compare the detected set with the argument passed to loss processing.

requirements.condition: After processing time-threshold losses
requirements.required_behavior: Reset the loss detection timer and return from timeout handling.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not fall through to anti-deadlock or PTO transmission after handling time-threshold losses.
requirements.why_checkable: A branch-level test can observe the timer reset and absence of later timeout-path actions.

requirements.quote:
if (no ack-eliciting packets in flight):
       assert(!PeerCompletedAddressValidation())
requirements.condition: When timeout handling finds no ACK-eliciting packets in flight
requirements.required_behavior: The peer must not already have completed address validation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not enter the anti-deadlock branch with address validation already complete.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat completed address validation in this branch as an assertion failure.
requirements.why_checkable: The in-flight set and validation state can be controlled and the assertion checked.

requirements.condition: When there are no ACK-eliciting packets in flight and Handshake keys are available
requirements.required_behavior: Send one ACK-eliciting Handshake packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send a padded Initial packet instead of the Handshake packet in this branch.
requirements.why_checkable: A timeout test with Handshake keys can count and classify emitted packets.

requirements.condition: When there are no ACK-eliciting packets in flight and Handshake keys are unavailable
requirements.required_behavior: Send one ACK-eliciting padded Initial packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send an unpadded Initial packet or a Handshake packet without Handshake keys.
requirements.why_checkable: A timeout test without Handshake keys can inspect the emitted packet's type, ACK-eliciting property, and padding.

requirements.quote:
// PTO. Send new data if available, else retransmit old data.
       // If neither is available, send a single PING frame.
requirements.condition: On PTO when new data is available
requirements.required_behavior: Prefer sending new data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retransmit old data or substitute a PING while new data is available.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary data availability and inspect the selected probe payload.

requirements.quote:
// PTO. Send new data if available, else retransmit old data.
       // If neither is available, send a single PING frame.
requirements.condition: On PTO when no new data is available but old data is available for retransmission
requirements.required_behavior: Retransmit old data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send a PING in place of available retransmittable data.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can provide only retransmittable old data and inspect the probe payload.

requirements.quote:
// PTO. Send new data if available, else retransmit old data.
       // If neither is available, send a single PING frame.
requirements.condition: On PTO when neither new data nor old retransmittable data is available
requirements.required_behavior: Send a single PING frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send more than one PING frame as the fallback probe payload.
requirements.why_checkable: A test with no data available can inspect the number and type of frames emitted.

requirements.condition: When ACK-eliciting packets are in flight and timeout handling enters the PTO branch
requirements.required_behavior: Select the PTO packet number space and send one or two ACK-eliciting packets in that space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send zero or more than two PTO probe packets, and do not send them in a different packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: The selected packet number space and emitted probe count are directly observable.

requirements.condition: After executing either the anti-deadlock or PTO send branch
requirements.required_behavior: Increment pto_count exactly once.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave pto_count unchanged or increment it more than once for one timeout execution.
requirements.why_checkable: The counter value can be compared immediately before and after timeout handling.

requirements.condition: After incrementing pto_count on the anti-deadlock or PTO path
requirements.required_behavior: Reset the loss detection timer.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave the prior loss detection timer unchanged after this timeout path.
requirements.why_checkable: The timer update can be observed after the timeout handler completes.

requirements.quote:
DetectAndRemoveLostPackets is called every time an ACK is received or
   the time threshold loss detection timer expires.
requirements.condition: Whenever an ACK is received
requirements.required_behavior: Call DetectAndRemoveLostPackets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not skip lost-packet detection for an ACK receipt.
requirements.why_checkable: An ACK-processing test can observe whether loss detection is invoked.

requirements.quote:
DetectAndRemoveLostPackets is called every time an ACK is received or
   the time threshold loss detection timer expires.
requirements.condition: Whenever the time-threshold loss detection timer expires
requirements.required_behavior: Call DetectAndRemoveLostPackets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not skip lost-packet detection for a time-threshold timer expiry.
requirements.why_checkable: A timer-expiry test can observe whether loss detection is invoked.

requirements.quote:
This function
   operates on the sent_packets for that packet number space and returns
   a list of packets newly detected as lost.
requirements.condition: When DetectAndRemoveLostPackets runs for a packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Operate only on sent_packets for that space and return the packets newly detected as lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not mutate another packet number space or return packets that were not newly detected as lost.
requirements.why_checkable: Per-space sent-packet state and the returned list can be compared before and after the call.

requirements.condition: On entry to DetectAndRemoveLostPackets
requirements.required_behavior: largest_acked_packet for the selected packet number space must be finite.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not run loss detection for a space with no finite largest acknowledged packet.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat an infinite largest_acked_packet value as an assertion failure.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply the sentinel value and verify assertion enforcement.

requirements.condition: At the start of DetectAndRemoveLostPackets
requirements.required_behavior: Clear loss_time for the selected packet number space before scanning packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain a stale loss time while recomputing loss state.
requirements.why_checkable: The per-space loss_time state can be inspected before packet iteration.

requirements.condition: At the start of DetectAndRemoveLostPackets
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize the newly lost packet result as an empty list.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not carry packets from an earlier loss-detection invocation into the result.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated calls can verify that the result accumulator is fresh for each invocation.

requirements.condition: When computing the time-threshold loss delay
requirements.required_behavior: Compute the preliminary loss delay as kTimeThreshold multiplied by the greater of latest_rtt and smoothed_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use the lesser RTT sample or omit the kTimeThreshold multiplier.
requirements.why_checkable: Known RTT and constant inputs yield an exact expected preliminary delay.

requirements.quote:
// Minimum time of kGranularity before packets are deemed lost.
     loss_delay = max(loss_delay, kGranularity)
requirements.condition: After computing the preliminary time-threshold loss delay
requirements.required_behavior: Clamp loss_delay to at least kGranularity.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a loss delay below kGranularity.
requirements.why_checkable: Inputs producing a preliminary delay below and above kGranularity can verify the clamp.

requirements.condition: After finalizing loss_delay
requirements.required_behavior: Set the lost-send-time cutoff to the current time minus loss_delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a cutoff computed from a different delay or time basis.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock and delay yield an exact expected cutoff.

requirements.condition: During DetectAndRemoveLostPackets
requirements.required_behavior: Evaluate every unacknowledged packet in sent_packets for the selected packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not evaluate packets from another space or omit an unacknowledged packet in the selected space.
requirements.why_checkable: A constructed sent-packet collection can verify per-element and per-space processing.

requirements.condition: When an unacknowledged packet number is greater than the largest acknowledged packet in the space
requirements.required_behavior: Skip loss evaluation for that packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not mark that packet lost or schedule a loss time for it in this scan.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet above largest_acked_packet can be checked for unchanged state after the scan.

requirements.quote:
// Note: The use of kPacketThreshold here assumes that there
       // were no sender-induced gaps in the packet number space.
requirements.condition: When using the shown kPacketThreshold arithmetic
requirements.required_behavior: Ensure the packet number space contains no sender-induced gaps.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply this arithmetic unchanged to a packet number space with sender-induced gaps.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet-number allocation can be inspected for gaps when this loss algorithm is selected.

requirements.condition: For an unacknowledged packet at or below largest_acked_packet
requirements.required_behavior: Classify it as lost when its send time is at or before lost_send_time, or when largest_acked_packet is at least its packet number plus kPacketThreshold.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not require both threshold conditions, and do not classify it as lost when neither condition holds.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary tests can independently exercise the time and packet-number predicates and their disjunction.

requirements.condition: When an unacknowledged packet satisfies either loss threshold
requirements.required_behavior: Remove the packet from sent_packets for its packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave a newly lost packet in the outstanding sent-packet collection.
requirements.why_checkable: The per-space sent-packet collection can be inspected after classification.

requirements.condition: When an unacknowledged packet satisfies either loss threshold
requirements.required_behavior: Insert the packet into the newly lost packet list.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit a newly lost packet from the returned lost-packet list.
requirements.why_checkable: The returned list can be compared with packets satisfying the threshold predicates.

requirements.condition: When a considered packet is not yet lost and loss_time for the space is zero
requirements.required_behavior: Set loss_time for the space to the packet's send time plus loss_delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave loss_time at zero or derive it from a different packet time.
requirements.why_checkable: Known packet send time and delay yield an exact expected state value.

requirements.condition: When a considered packet is not yet lost and loss_time for the space is already nonzero
requirements.required_behavior: Set loss_time to the earlier of its current value and the packet's send time plus loss_delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not move loss_time later than either candidate time.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests with candidate times before and after the current value can verify minimum selection.

requirements.condition: After scanning sent_packets for the selected packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Return the accumulated list of newly lost packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not return packets that remain unclassified as lost.
requirements.why_checkable: The function result can be compared directly with the set accumulated during the scan.

requirements.condition: On entry to OnPacketNumberSpaceDiscarded
requirements.required_behavior: The packet number space being discarded must not be ApplicationData.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use this discard operation for the Application Data packet number space.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat ApplicationData as an assertion failure.
requirements.why_checkable: Calling the operation with each packet number space can verify the asserted precondition.

requirements.condition: When discarding the Initial or Handshake packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Remove all sent packets in that space from the bytes-in-flight accounting.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain discarded-space packets in bytes-in-flight accounting.
requirements.why_checkable: Bytes-in-flight can be compared before and after discarding a populated space.

requirements.condition: When discarding the Initial or Handshake packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Clear the sent-packet collection for that space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain sent-packet records for a discarded packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: The per-space sent-packet collection can be inspected after discard.

requirements.condition: When discarding the Initial or Handshake packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Reset time_of_last_ack_eliciting_packet for that space to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain the prior ACK-eliciting send time for a discarded space.
requirements.why_checkable: The per-space timestamp can be inspected immediately after discard.

requirements.condition: When discarding the Initial or Handshake packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Reset loss_time for that space to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain a pending loss time for a discarded space.
requirements.why_checkable: The per-space loss timer state can be inspected immediately after discard.

requirements.condition: When discarding the Initial or Handshake packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Reset pto_count to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not preserve the previous PTO backoff count after discarding the space.
requirements.why_checkable: The PTO counter can be inspected immediately after discard.

requirements.condition: After clearing the discarded space and resetting its loss-detection state
requirements.required_behavior: Recompute and set the loss detection timer.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave the loss detection timer based on discarded packet state.
requirements.why_checkable: The timer value and its inputs can be observed after packet-number-space discard.
